title: Unbounded derived section comparison for acyclic quasi-coherent pushforward
statement: Let f:X\to Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] such that R^p f_* F=0 for every quasi-coherent O_X-module F and every p>0. For an affine open V\subseteq Y and an object E of D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], the canonical comparison supplied by the right derived section functor identifies H^i(R\Gamma(f^{-1}(V),E)) with \Gamma(f^{-1}(V),H^i(E)) for every integer i, naturally in E; these identifications are compatible with restriction to smaller affine opens. Moreover, as V varies, the presheaf V\mapsto H^i(R\Gamma(f^{-1}(V),E)) has sheafification canonically identified with H^i(Rf_*E) [def-pc-derived-direct-image].

source.place: Tag 08D4, parts (1) and (2) with N=1, applied to F=Gamma(f^{-1}(V),-) as in Tag 08D5 and Tag 0AVW; the sheafification identification is the standard higher-direct-image construction used in Tag 0AVW
